content.title: Gas Savings for Delivery Drivers
content.text: We know the price of gas is top of mind for many delivery drivers across the country right now. To help mitigate the exceptional and rapid price increases that drivers have been seeing at the pump, we are significantly expanding the fuel discounts and offers available to Uber couriers through May 26, 2026. We are also increasing incentives and promos for couriers to help ensure that their earnings keep pace with higher gas prices.Expanded rebates and discounts on gas through Uber Eats Pro*Every driver and courier can now get an additional 5% cash back—on top of existing rates—at any gas station in the country with an Uber Pro Card, no matter their Uber Pro or Uber Eats Pro tier.** Blue/Green now earns 7% cash back Gold earns 8% Platinum earns 9% Diamond earns 11% Plus an additional 3% cash back at Exxon™ or Mobil™ gas pumps and another 1% cash back at Mastercard Easy Savings stations, meaning top drivers and couriers can now get up to an industry-leading 15% cash back at the pump—up from the previous 10% max rate. Significantly expanded discounts on gas via Upside and Shell Fuel Rewards:*** Shell® Fuel Rewards® program: Delivery drivers can get up to 21¢ off per gallon of gas with Shell (up from max 7¢ per gallon) Upside: Delivery drivers can now get up to $1.00 off per gallon off of gas with Upside (up from max 25¢ per gallon) Offers from Upside and Shell Fuel Rewards can each be individually combined with the Uber Pro Card, netting even more savings.Altogether, top-tier couriers can save up to $1.44 per gallon when they fill up their gas tank using these combined offers and discounts. These savings via the Uber Pro Card, Upside, and Shell Fuel Rewards will begin on Friday, March 27 and remain in place in the U.S. through May 26, 2026.Increased promos and incentives for delivery driversWe are additionally providing mileage-based relief for delivery drivers that will be paid out on a weekly basis starting on Monday, March 30th, based on a driver’s utilized mileage that week. This incentive is initially set to end on May 3, 2026. After 125 miles on active deliveries, delivery drivers will get $5 on top of your earnings and tips. After 200 miles on active deliveries, delivery drivers get $10 on top of your earnings and tips. After 250 miles on active deliveries, delivery drivers get $15 on top of your earnings and tips. For the purposes of this reward, miles for active deliveries are calculated from the moment you accept the order through drop-off. This incentive is currently set to end on May 3, 2026. We are also investing in promos and incentives across the board for drivers and couriers to help offset higher gas prices, as well as continuing to find ways to support drivers who want to transition to electric vehicles. Uber drivers already make up the largest electric vehicle fleet out of any ridehail platform in the world, with 286,000 monthly active ZEV drivers. Uber Pro terms apply. See Uber Pro terms and conditions. See Uber Eats Pro terms and conditions.*All mentioned promotions may be modified or changed at any time, without notice, in Uber’s sole discretion, subject to applicable law.**Banking services are provided by Evolve Bank & Trust, Member FDIC. The Uber Pro Card is a Mastercard debit card powered by Branch and issued by Evolve Bank & Trust pursuant to a license from Mastercard and may be used everywhere Mastercard debit cards are accepted. Uber is not responsible for the products and/or services offered by other companies, or for the terms and conditions (including financial terms) under which those products and/or services are offered. Exxon and Mobil are trademarks or registered trademarks of Exxon Mobil Corporation or one of its subsidiaries. Other trademarks shown are property of their respective owners.Up to 15% is available for drivers and couriers with Diamond status who pay with the Uber Pro Card at the pump at ExxonMobilᵀᴹ stations associated with the Mastercard Easy Savings program. Base cash back benefit is between 7% and 11% for gas purchases, depending on your Uber Pro status. Total cash back you can earn with the Uber Pro Card on refueling (gas or EV charging) is $105 per month, excluding any Mastercard Easy Savings cash back (see their Terms and Conditions here. Mastercard Easy Savings may not be available in all locations. For more information on Mastercard Easy Savings, visit their Terms and Conditions page here. Select Credit or Bypass PIN to receive cash back for qualifying purchases. Selecting Debit or entering your PIN number will disqualify your purchase from earning cash back. In addition, only payments made at the pump are eligible. Please visit Uber Pro Card Rewards Terms & Conditions for more information on how to qualify your purchase for cash back.***Upside: Each deal is valid for up to 50 gallons. You can claim up to 5 fuel offers daily. You’re limited to 2 offers per gas station each day. See Upside Terms. See Shell® Fuel Rewards® Terms for details on those terms.
